How do you use crease patterns?

I'd recommend starting up with easy ones. You can use this or other websites to get steps/tutorials on doing it.

On this example, first image, it will have creases that runs across the paper. It is a sign to show where the paper will be folded. Some tutorials include arrows depicting where it will be folded. Some even have animation/gif of it.

Some other examples you can try out.

As you do those more and look up different kinds of tutorials, you'll get a hang on what kind of folds you need to make in order to get to the final product.
